title: Shift Briefing

text.ms: This shift: keep the dome alive. Watch air, water, and power. Mars weather can change fast, so keep some power in reserve. Keep life support steady for {hold_sols} sols and the relay link comes back. If something nearly fails, ask why.

source: docs/design/landing-spec.md section 5.3 with the Instructional Designer changes W1 to W7 (section 12). 24 h 40 min in journal.sol, the Earth line and its HS sentence in journal.dome.stable are pending SME confirmation (unverified).
